subject: Exclusive Offer Inside - Limited Time Only!
body: Dear valued customer, We are excited to offer you an exclusive 20% discount on your next purchase as a token of our appreciation. Simply use the code 'VIP20' at checkout to redeem this special offer. This promotion is valid for the next 5 days only, so don't miss out on this opportunity to save on your favorite products.
